title_en: Course Advising Guidance for the Second Semester of the 2026 Academic Year
summary: Undergraduate students must apply for online course advising and receive advising from their academic advisor between 7 July and 21 July 2026, before registering for second-semester courses. Only applications submitted through the online system (http://sugang.snu.ac.kr) are accepted.
applies_to: Enrolled students and students scheduled to return from leave for the second semester of the 2026 academic year, excluding students expected to graduate in August 2026.

dates.what: Student application period for online course advising

steps: Between 7 July and 21 July 2026, log in at http://sugang.snu.ac.kr.

Search for the courses you plan to take (Course Search [강좌검색]) and save them as Courses of Interest [관심강좌저장]. Courses must be saved as Courses of Interest before they can be registered for advising. Save all courses, but if you saved several sections of one course, include only one representative section in your application.
Go to Course Advising Consultation [수강지도상담] → Course Advising Application [수강지도신청].
Select your advising major [수강지도전공 선택] and register the courses for advising [수강지도과목 등록].
Enter your reason for taking the courses [수강사유 기재] (required).
Submit the application [신청]. You may cancel or modify it after submission. An e-mail is sent automatically to your academic advisor.

Check the advising result, either at http://sugang.snu.ac.kr → Course Advising Consultation [수강지도상담] → Detailed View for the Semester [해당학기상세조회], or at http://my.snu.ac.kr → Academic Information [학사정보] → Classes/Grades [수업/성적] → Classes [수업] → Course Advising History [수강지도내역확인] → Detailed View for the Semester [해당학기상세조회].
If your application is returned with a request to change your course plan [반려], change the courses in your Courses of Interest and reapply online to your advisor.
translation:
Course Advising Guidance for the Second Semester of the 2026 Academic Year

Posted: 3 July 2026

Our school requires students to apply for course advising every semester so that they register for courses correctly. Online course advising for undergraduate students is announced below. Please make sure to receive advising from your academic advisor within the stated period.

The course curriculum table for the second semester of 2026 and the manual on how to apply for online course advising are attached; please refer to them when applying. (Note: the attachments were not read; their content is not included in this translation.)

1. How to apply for online course advising and check approval (see the attached manual)

A. How to apply: Log in at http://sugang.snu.ac.kr → Course Search [강좌검색] → Save as Course of Interest [관심강좌저장] → Course Advising Consultation [수강지도상담] → Course Advising Application [수강지도신청] → Select advising major [수강지도전공 선택] → Register advising courses [수강지도과목 등록] → Enter reason for taking the course [수강사유 기재] (required) → Submit [신청] (the submitted application can be cancelled or modified) → An e-mail notifying the advisor of the application is sent automatically.

B. How to check approval: Log in at http://sugang.snu.ac.kr → Course Advising Consultation [수강지도상담] → Detailed View for the Semester [해당학기상세조회]; or log in at http://my.snu.ac.kr → Academic Information [학사정보] → Classes/Grades [수업/성적] → Classes [수업] → Course Advising History [수강지도내역확인] → Detailed View for the Semester [해당학기상세조회].

2. Points to note when applying online

A. After searching for the courses you will take, you must save them as Courses of Interest [관심강좌]; only then can they be registered as advising courses.

B. When saving Courses of Interest, save all courses; however, if you have saved several sections of one course, apply with only the representative section. (*Applications that include several sections of the same course may be returned.)

C. You must check the advising result. If there is a request to change your course registration plan (returned [반려]), change the courses in your Courses of Interest and reapply online to your advisor.

D. Only online course advising applications (http://sugang.snu.ac.kr) are accepted. (Approval by other means, e.g. by e-mail, is not accepted.)

3. Eligibility: Enrolled students and students scheduled to return from leave for the second semester of 2026 (excluding students expected to graduate in August 2026).

4. Course advising schedule

A. Student application period: Tuesday 7 July 2026 – Tuesday 21 July 2026
* Even if the system remains open and applications can be submitted outside the student application period, applications submitted after the period will be returned.

B. Advisor advising period: Tuesday 7 July 2026 – Friday 24 July 2026

C. Staff confirmation period: Wednesday 22 July 2026 – Monday 27 July 2026

5. Note: If you register for courses at your own discretion without receiving course advising, restrictions may be imposed regarding the following:

A. Scholarship recommendation

B. Selection as a mentee in the alumni mentoring program

6. Inquiries: The department office [학부사무실]. The contact details are given in the original notice.
